info.text:
By the 30% rule, Corcoran's September 2026 Manhattan median rent needed a $215,800 salary.

Corcoran's Manhattan median rent hit a record $5,395 a month in September 2026.
Nationally, Census median asking rent rose from $1,008 (Q2 2019) to $1,531 (Q2 2026).
Freddie Mac estimated a 3.7 million home shortfall as of Q3 2024.
In 2024, a record 22.7 million renter households (49%) paid over 30% of income on housing.

Sources: Corcoran (Sept 2026), Census Housing Vacancy Survey, Freddie Mac via CRS, NAHB/NMHC (2022), Harvard JCHS (2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
